scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-I
other_conditions: One spouse must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe while the other spouse must be from a different community
The bride must have passed the 10th standard (or the 5th standard if the bride belongs to a Scheduled Tribe)
The application must be submitted within two years from the date of marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000, with ₹15,000 transferred electronically, ₹10,000 as a National Savings Certificate, and a 22‑carat gold coin.
